steps.name: environment - install Swift toolchain and persist PATH safely
steps.description: Install a Swift toolchain compatible with Ubuntu 24.04 into /opt (versioned directory) and persist PATH via /etc/profile.d without expanding the current PATH at write time. The script is idempotent: it checks for an existing /opt/swift and for swift on PATH, installs small prerequisites only when missing (jq), supports SWIFT_VERSION or SWIFT_URL overrides, verifies optional SHA256, extracts into a temporary directory then moves atomically into /opt, validates swift --version, and sets CI/NODE_ENV via a separate configuration step. Operates in workspace /home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/swift-recipe-explorer-321166-321175/swift_frontend.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WS="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/swift-recipe-explorer-321166-321175/swift_frontend"
SWIFT_VERSION_OVERRIDE="${SWIFT_VERSION:-}"
SWIFT_URL_OVERRIDE="${SWIFT_URL:-}"
SWIFT_SHA256_OVERRIDE="${SWIFT_SHA256:-}"
SWIFT_PREFIX_BASE=/opt
# ensure jq present only if needed
if ! command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then sudo apt-get update -q && sudo apt-get install -yq jq || { echo "apt install jq failed" >&2; exit 2; }; fi
# if swift already available, skip install
if command -v swift >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "swift present: $(swift --version | head -n1)"; exit 0; fi
# require explicit version for reproducibility unless URL provided
if [ -n "$SWIFT_URL_OVERRIDE" ]; then URL="$SWIFT_URL_OVERRIDE"; else
  if [ -n "$SWIFT_VERSION_OVERRIDE" ]; then VER="$SWIFT_VERSION_OVERRIDE"; URL="https://download.swift.org/swift-${VER}-release/ubuntu2404/swift-${VER}-RELEASE/swift-${VER}-RELEASE-ubuntu24.04.tar.gz"; else
    echo "Please provide SWIFT_VERSION or SWIFT_URL to install Swift (avoiding unpredictable latest)." >&2; exit 3
  fi
fi
TMPDIR="/tmp/swift-install-$$" && rm -rf "$TMPDIR" && mkdir -p "$TMPDIR"
ARCHIVE="$TMPDIR/swift.tar.gz"
# download with retries
RETRIES=3; SLEEP=2; i=0
until [ $i -ge $RETRIES ]; do
  if curl -fSL --retry 3 --retry-delay 2 "$URL" -o "$ARCHIVE"; then break; fi
  i=$((i+1)); sleep $SLEEP; SLEEP=$((SLEEP*2))
done
[ -s "$ARCHIVE" ] || { echo "Failed to download Swift from $URL" >&2; rm -rf "$TMPDIR"; exit 11; }
# optional sha256 verification when provided
if [ -n "$SWIFT_SHA256_OVERRIDE" ]; then echo "$SWIFT_SHA256_OVERRIDE  $ARCHIVE" > "$TMPDIR/check.sum" && (cd "$TMPDIR" && sha256sum -c check.sum) || { echo "Swift checksum mismatch" >&2; rm -rf "$TMPDIR"; exit 12; }; fi
sudo mkdir -p "$SWIFT_PREFIX_BASE"
# extract into tmp and locate top-level directory robustly
sudo tar -xzf "$ARCHIVE" -C "$TMPDIR" || { echo "tar extraction failed" >&2; rm -rf "$TMPDIR"; exit 13; }
# find the first directory inside TMPDIR that looks like swift-* or contains usr/bin/swift
TOPDIR=""
for d in "$TMPDIR"/*; do
  if [ -d "$d" ]; then
    if [ -x "$d/usr/bin/swift" ] || [[ "$(basename "$d")" == swift-* ]]; then TOPDIR="$(basename "$d")"; break; fi
  fi
done
if [ -z "$TOPDIR" ]; then echo "Failed to detect extracted Swift directory" >&2; rm -rf "$TMPDIR"; exit 14; fi
TARGET_DIR="$SWIFT_PREFIX_BASE/$TOPDIR"
if [ -d "$TARGET_DIR" ]; then echo "$TARGET_DIR exists, skipping move"; else sudo mv "$TMPDIR/$TOPDIR" "$TARGET_DIR"; fi
sudo ln -sfn "$TARGET_DIR" "/opt/swift"
# write profile.d without expanding $PATH at write time
sudo bash -c 'cat >/etc/profile.d/swift.sh <<\'EOF\'
# Swift toolchain
export PATH="/opt/swift/usr/bin:$PATH"
EOF'
sudo chmod 644 /etc/profile.d/swift.sh
# validate
SWIFT_BIN="/opt/swift/usr/bin/swift"
if [ ! -x "$SWIFT_BIN" ]; then echo "swift binary not found at $SWIFT_BIN" >&2; exit 15; fi
"$SWIFT_BIN" --version | head -n1
# make available for the current script execution
export PATH="/opt/swift/usr/bin:$PATH"
rm -rf "$TMPDIR"

steps.name: scaffolding - initialize Swift package, Makefile and npm scripts (idempotent)
steps.description: Create an idempotent Swift Package layout using the package name discovered from Package.swift or provided via SWIFT_PKG_NAME. Initialize non-interactively if missing, create Sources/<PackageName>/main.swift, create package.json (devDependency 'serve' pinned) only if missing and avoid unnecessary npm network downloads when node_modules exists. Write a Makefile that correctly escapes runtime PID handling so the server records $! at runtime. Operates in workspace /home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/swift-recipe-explorer-321166-321175/swift_frontend.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WS="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/swift-recipe-explorer-321166-321175/swift_frontend"
mkdir -p "$WS" && cd "$WS"
# ensure swift available in this shell
if ! command -v swift >/dev/null 2>&1; then export PATH="/opt/swift/usr/bin:$PATH"; fi
# determine package name
PKG_NAME_OVERRIDE="${SWIFT_PKG_NAME:-}"
if [ -n "$PKG_NAME_OVERRIDE" ]; then PKG_NAME="$PKG_NAME_OVERRIDE"; else
  if [ -f Package.swift ]; then
    PKG_NAME="$(swift package dump-package 2>/dev/null | (command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 && jq -r .name || python3 -c 'import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin).get("name",""))') )"
  fi
fi
if [ -z "${PKG_NAME:-}" ]; then PKG_NAME="swift_frontend"; fi
# initialize package non-interactively if missing
if [ ! -f Package.swift ]; then swift package init --name "$PKG_NAME" --type executable; fi
# Sources main
MAIN_DIR="$WS/Sources/$PKG_NAME"
mkdir -p "$MAIN_DIR"
MAIN_FILE="$MAIN_DIR/main.swift"
if [ ! -f "$MAIN_FILE" ]; then cat > "$MAIN_FILE" <<'SW'
import Foundation
print("Hello Swift Frontend")
SW
fi
# package.json only when missing (pin serve) - do not force network if node_modules exists
PKG_JSON="$WS/package.json"
if [ ! -f "$PKG_JSON" ]; then
  cat > "$PKG_JSON" <<'NP'
{
  "name": "swift-frontend-static",
  "version": "0.0.1",
  "scripts": {
    "build": "echo \"no-op: swift builds handled via Makefile\"",
    "serve": "./node_modules/.bin/serve -s ./public -l 8080"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "serve": "14.0.1"
  }
}
NP
  # create package-lock deterministically by allowing npm to compute lock only when network available; we don't force install here
  npm i --package-lock-only --no-audit --no-fund >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
fi
# install npm deps only when node_modules missing
if [ ! -d node_modules ]; then npm i --no-audit --no-fund || { echo "npm install failed" >&2; exit 20; }; fi
# Write Makefile protecting $! expansion so it is evaluated at runtime
cat > Makefile <<'MK'
.PHONY: build test package serve stop-serve
build:
	 swift build -c release

test:
	 swift test

package:
	 mkdir -p public
	 if [ -d Resources ]; then cp -r Resources/* public/ || true; fi

serve:
	 ./node_modules/.bin/serve -s ./public -l 8080 > .serve.log 2>&1 &
	 echo \$! > .serve.pid

stop-serve:
	 [ -f .serve.pid ] && kill "$(cat .serve.pid)" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
	 rm -f .serve.pid || true
MK

steps.name: dependencies - install optional SwiftWasm (carton) and optional UI tooling
steps.description: Install optional SwiftWasm helper 'carton' when BUILD_WASM=1. The installer detects whether the release asset is a raw binary or an archive (.tar.gz) and handles extraction accordingly, verifies optional SHA256, installs into /usr/local/bin with correct permissions, and writes /etc/profile.d/carton.sh safely. For UI tests when BUILD_UI_TESTS=1, it installs puppeteer-core as devDependency (without forcing Chromium download) and ensures a system Chromium is present by detecting 'chromium-browser' or 'chromium' before attempting apt install (fail fast on apt errors). Operates in workspace /home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/swift-recipe-explorer-321166-321175/swift_frontend.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WS="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/swift-recipe-explorer-321166-321175/swift_frontend"
cd "$WS"
# ensure swift in PATH
if ! command -v swift >/dev/null 2>&1; then export PATH="/opt/swift/usr/bin:$PATH"; fi
# carton install when requested
if [ "${BUILD_WASM:-0}" = "1" ]; then
  CARTON_URL="${CARTON_URL:-}"
  CARTON_SHA256="${CARTON_SHA256:-}"
  ARCH="$(uname -m)"
  case "$ARCH" in
    x86_64|amd64) DEF_NAME_PREFIX="carton-linux-amd64" ;;
    aarch64|arm64) DEF_NAME_PREFIX="carton-linux-arm64" ;;
    *) echo "Unsupported arch $ARCH for carton" >&2; exit 21 ;;
  esac
  if [ -z "$CARTON_URL" ]; then CARTON_URL="https://github.com/swiftwasm/carton/releases/latest/download/${DEF_NAME_PREFIX}"; fi
  TMPDIR="/tmp/carton-install-$$" && rm -rf "$TMPDIR" && mkdir -p "$TMPDIR"
  TMPF="$TMPDIR/asset"
  curl -fSL --retry 3 --retry-delay 2 "$CARTON_URL" -o "$TMPF" || { echo "Failed to download carton from $CARTON_URL" >&2; rm -rf "$TMPDIR"; exit 22; }
  [ -s "$TMPF" ] || { echo "Empty carton asset" >&2; rm -rf "$TMPDIR"; exit 23; }
  # verify sha if provided
  if [ -n "$CARTON_SHA256" ]; then echo "$CARTON_SHA256  $TMPF" > "$TMPDIR/carton.sum" && sha256sum -c "$TMPDIR/carton.sum" || { echo "carton checksum mismatch" >&2; rm -rf "$TMPDIR"; exit 24; }; fi
  # detect archive vs raw binary
  if file "$TMPF" | grep -qi 'gzip compressed data\|tar archive'; then
    tar -xzf "$TMPF" -C "$TMPDIR" || { echo "Failed to extract carton archive" >&2; rm -rf "$TMPDIR"; exit 25; }
    # find binary
    BIN_PATH="$(find "$TMPDIR" -type f -name 'carton*' -perm /111 | head -n1 || true)"
    [ -n "$BIN_PATH" ] || { echo "carton binary not found inside archive" >&2; rm -rf "$TMPDIR"; exit 26; }
  else
    BIN_PATH="$TMPF"
  fi
  sudo mv "$BIN_PATH" /usr/local/bin/carton
  sudo chmod 0755 /usr/local/bin/carton
  sudo chown root:root /usr/local/bin/carton
  sudo bash -c 'cat >/etc/profile.d/carton.sh <<\'EOF\'
# carton helper
export PATH="/usr/local/bin:$PATH"
EOF'
  sudo chmod 644 /etc/profile.d/carton.sh
  command -v carton >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "carton not available after install" >&2; rm -rf "$TMPDIR"; exit 27; }
  carton --version || true
  rm -rf "$TMPDIR"
fi
# optional UI tooling
if [ "${BUILD_UI_TESTS:-0}" = "1" ]; then
  if ! command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 || ! command -v npm >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "node/npm required for UI tests" >&2; exit 28; fi
  # install puppeteer-core as devDependency without forcing Chromium download
  export PUPPETEER_SKIP_CHROMIUM_DOWNLOAD=1
  npm i --no-audit --no-fund --save-dev puppeteer-core || { echo "npm install puppeteer-core failed" >&2; exit 29; }
  # detect system chromium
  if command -v chromium-browser >/dev/null 2>&1 || command -v chromium >/dev/null 2>&1 || command -v google-chrome >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "System Chromium present"
  else
    # try apt install chromium-browser (fail fast if apt fails)
    sudo apt-get update -q && sudo apt-get install -yq chromium-browser || { echo "Failed to install chromium-browser; ensure a Chromium is available or provide PUPPETEER_EXECUTABLE_PATH" >&2; exit 30; }
  fi
fi

    *) echo "Unsupported arch $ARCH for carton" >&2; exit 21 ;;
  esac
  if [ -z "$CARTON_URL" ]; then CARTON_URL="https://github.com/swiftwasm/carton/releases/latest/download/${DEF_NAME_PREFIX}"; fi

  # skip if already installed and executable
  if command -v carton >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "carton already installed"
  else
    TMPDIR="/tmp/carton-install-$$" && rm -rf "$TMPDIR" && mkdir -p "$TMPDIR"
    TMPF="$TMPDIR/asset"
    curl -fSL --retry 3 --retry-delay 2 "$CARTON_URL" -o "$TMPF" || { echo "Failed to download carton from $CARTON_URL" >&2; rm -rf "$TMPDIR"; exit 22; }
    [ -s "$TMPF" ] || { echo "Empty carton asset" >&2; rm -rf "$TMPDIR"; exit 23; }
    if [ -n "$CARTON_SHA256" ]; then echo "$CARTON_SHA256  $TMPF" > "$TMPDIR/carton.sum" && sha256sum -c "$TMPDIR/carton.sum" || { echo "carton checksum mismatch" >&2; rm -rf "$TMPDIR"; exit 24; }; fi
    # detect archive vs raw binary
    if file "$TMPF" | grep -qi 'gzip compressed data\|tar archive'; then
      tar -xzf "$TMPF" -C "$TMPDIR" || { echo "Failed to extract carton archive" >&2; rm -rf "$TMPDIR"; exit 25; }
      BIN_PATH="$(find "$TMPDIR" -type f -name 'carton*' -perm /111 | head -n1 || true)"
      [ -n "$BIN_PATH" ] || { echo "carton binary not found inside archive" >&2; rm -rf "$TMPDIR"; exit 26; }
    else
      BIN_PATH="$TMPF"
    fi
    sudo mv "$BIN_PATH" /usr/local/bin/carton
    sudo chmod 0755 /usr/local/bin/carton
    sudo chown root:root /usr/local/bin/carton
    # write profile.d without expanding $PATH at write time
    sudo bash -c 'cat >/etc/profile.d/carton.sh <<\'EOF\'
# carton helper
export PATH="/usr/local/bin:$PATH"
EOF'
    sudo chmod 0644 /etc/profile.d/carton.sh
    command -v carton >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "carton not available after install" >&2; rm -rf "$TMPDIR"; exit 27; }
    carton --version || true
    rm -rf "$TMPDIR"
  fi
fi

# UI tooling when requested
if [ "${BUILD_UI_TESTS:-0}" = "1" ]; then
  if ! command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 || ! command -v npm >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "node/npm required for UI tests" >&2; exit 28; fi
  export PUPPETEER_SKIP_CHROMIUM_DOWNLOAD=1
  # prefer adding to package.json devDependencies if package.json exists, else run npm i to create package.json
  if [ -f package.json ]; then
    npm i --no-audit --no-fund --save-dev puppeteer-core || { echo "npm install puppeteer-core failed" >&2; exit 29; }
  else
    npm init -y >/dev/null 2>&1
    npm i --no-audit --no-fund --save-dev puppeteer-core || { echo "npm install puppeteer-core failed" >&2; exit 29; }
  fi
  # detect system chromium
  if command -v chromium-browser >/dev/null 2>&1 || command -v chromium >/dev/null 2>&1 || command -v google-chrome >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    : # present
  else
    # Try installing chromium-browser via apt; fail fast on apt errors
    sudo apt-get update -q && sudo apt-get install -yq chromium-browser || { echo "Failed to install chromium-browser; ensure Chromium is available or provide PUPPETEER_EXECUTABLE_PATH" >&2; exit 30; }
  fi
fi
